items.name: base
items.title: renan/ui
items.description: Everything: tokens, default theme, utils and all components.

items.name: tokens
items.title: Design tokens
items.description: Layer-2 tokens (control size, control radius, shadows) on top of the shadcn theme contract.

@utility motion-press.transition: transform var(--ds-duration-press) var(--ds-ease-out), background-color var(--ds-duration-press) ease, color var(--ds-duration-press) ease, box-shadow var(--ds-duration-press) ease

@utility motion-popover.transition: opacity var(--ds-duration-popover) var(--ds-motion-ease, var(--ds-ease-out)), transform var(--ds-duration-popover) var(--ds-motion-ease, var(--ds-ease-out))

@utility motion-tooltip.transition: opacity var(--ds-duration-tooltip) var(--ds-motion-ease, var(--ds-ease-out)), transform var(--ds-duration-tooltip) var(--ds-motion-ease, var(--ds-ease-out))

@utility motion-modal.transition: opacity var(--ds-duration-modal) var(--ds-motion-ease, var(--ds-ease-out)), transform var(--ds-duration-modal) var(--ds-motion-ease, var(--ds-ease-out))

items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: Stacked sections that expand one or several at a time.

items.name: alert-dialog
items.title: Alert Dialog
items.description: Asks for confirmation before a destructive action.

items.name: alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: An inline message, as a bordered card or a tinted callout.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: A user's picture with initials as fallback, alone or stacked.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: Status pills and counts in seven contrast-checked tones.

items.name: breadcrumb
items.title: Breadcrumb
items.description: Where this page sits in the hierarchy, with links back up.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Actions with press feedback, a smooth loading state and an optional hotkey.

items.name: calendar
items.title: Calendar
items.description: A month grid for picking a day or a range (react-day-picker).

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: A surface with a header, content and footer.

items.name: chart
items.title: Chart
items.description: Recharts with a validated categorical palette, DS tooltips and legends.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: On, off or mixed. The whole label toggles it.

items.name: combobox
items.title: Combobox
items.description: Type to filter a list and pick one value.

items.name: command
items.title: Command
items.description: A searchable list of commands, inline or as a Mod+K palette.

items.name: data-list
items.title: Data List
items.description: Label and value pairs that reflow with their container.

items.name: date-picker
items.title: Date Picker
items.description: A button that opens a calendar, for a single date or a range.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: A modal window. Becomes a bottom drawer on phones.

items.name: drawer
items.title: Drawer
items.description: A panel that slides in from an edge and follows your finger.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.title: Dropdown Menu
items.description: A list of actions, with hotkeys, checkboxes, radios and submenus.

items.name: empty
items.title: Empty
items.description: What a region shows when there is nothing in it yet, and how to fill it.

items.name: error-state
items.title: Error State
items.description: A region that failed to load: what failed, a retry, and a request ID for support.

items.name: field
items.title: Field
items.description: Label, control, description and error laid out together, vertically or horizontally.

items.name: file-dropzone
items.title: File Dropzone
items.description: Drop files or browse, with type and size limits and a removable list.

items.name: form
items.title: Form
items.description: react-hook-form and zod wired to fields: validation on blur, then live; a banner for server errors.

items.name: hotkey
items.title: Hotkey
items.description: Shows a shortcut for the user's platform: Mod+K reads ⌘K on macOS and Ctrl K elsewhere.

items.name: icon-tile
items.title: Icon Tile
items.description: An icon on a tinted square: the leading visual of rows, dialogs and results.

items.name: input-group
items.title: Input Group
items.description: An input with leading or trailing addons: icons, text, buttons.

items.name: input-otp
items.title: Input OTP
items.description: One-time codes for 2FA and email verification.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: Single-line text field sized by the control tokens.

items.name: item
items.title: Item
items.description: A row with media, title, description and actions.

items.name: kbd
items.title: Kbd
items.description: A key cap.

items.name: label
items.title: Label
items.description: Names a control. Clicking it focuses or toggles the control.

items.name: multi-select
items.title: Multi Select
items.description: Pick several values as removable tags, with type-to-filter.

items.name: native-select
items.title: Native Select
items.description: The platform select, styled like the rest of the controls.

items.name: pagination
items.title: Pagination
items.description: Links between pages of results.

items.name: panel
items.title: Panel
items.description: A tinted tray holding white cards with concentric corners.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: Rich content anchored to a trigger. A bottom sheet on phones.

items.name: progress
items.title: Progress
items.description: How far along a task is.

items.name: radio-group
items.title: Radio Group
items.description: Pick exactly one of a few visible options.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: Pick one option from a list. The popup lines its selected item up with the trigger.

items.name: separator
items.title: Separator
items.description: A thin rule between content.

items.name: sheet
items.title: Sheet
items.description: A side panel for filters, details and navigation.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: Placeholders shaped like the content that is loading.

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: Pick a value or a range by dragging.

items.name: sonner
items.title: Toast
items.description: Transient notifications, including undo for reversible actions.

items.name: sortable
items.title: Sortable
items.description: A list you reorder by dragging, or with the keyboard.

items.name: spinner
items.title: Spinner
items.description: An indeterminate progress indicator.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: A setting that applies immediately when toggled.

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: Semantic table parts. For sorting, filters and pages use the Data Table block.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Switch between views, as pills, a line or a sliding segmented control.

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: Multi-line text that grows with its content.

items.name: toggle-group
items.title: Toggle Group
items.description: A row of toggles, single or multiple choice: alignment, view modes, filters.

items.name: toggle
items.title: Toggle
items.description: A button that stays pressed: bold on, bold off.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: A short label for an icon or a hint, with an optional hotkey.

items.name: app-shell
items.title: App shell
items.description: Collapsible sidebar (variant="fade": labels fade and blur out, icons never move), nested groups, Mod+K palette, G-then-key navigation, a sheet on mobile.

items.name: auth
items.title: Sign in
items.description: Google and SSO, email and password, and a banner for server errors.

items.name: billing
items.title: Pricing and billing
items.description: Monthly or yearly plans, usage meters and invoices.

items.name: dashboard
items.title: Dashboard
items.description: KPI tiles with sparklines, revenue and signup charts, activity and top projects; the range lives in the URL.

items.name: data-table
items.title: Data table
items.description: Search, filters, sort and pages kept in the URL, bulk actions and every loading state.

items.name: error-pages
items.title: Not found
items.description: 404, 403, 500 and maintenance pages with the way out.

items.name: notifications
items.title: Notifications
items.description: A bell menu with unread count (Shift+N) and a full feed with mark as read and archive with undo.

items.name: onboarding
items.title: First-run intro
items.description: A product area's empty page as an invitation: two-line title, pill actions, art bleeding off the corner, a hint.

items.name: settings
items.title: Settings
items.description: Profile form, members and roles, and a delete confirmed by typing the name.
